title: +*INTRODUCTION TO THE VISUAL ARTS
description: Introduces the discipline of visual art. Examines the motivations of human creative enterprise. Emphasizes the materials and methods employed by artists, architects, and creatives in the production of artworks throughout history and up to the present. Explores the structures, language, and ideas that make up our shared and individual visual experiences.
